# Copilot Rules for This Project

## Always do first
- Read `PROJECT.md` in the repo root before generating or changing any code.
- If a request conflicts with PROJECT.md, STOP and tell me instead of proceeding.

## Hard constraints
- Do NOT change the tech stack, framework, language versions, or package manager.
- Do NOT add new dependencies or libraries without asking me first.
- Do NOT modify anything inside `/backend` (or the files I list as protected) unless I explicitly say so.
- Do NOT rename, move, or delete existing files/folders.
- Do NOT change existing API routes, request/response shapes, or env variable names.
- Frontend must only talk to the backend through the endpoints documented in PROJECT.md.

## Working style
- Make the smallest change that does the job; touch only the files I name.
- Before big changes, give me a short plan and the list of files you'll create/edit, then wait for approval.
- Match the existing code style and folder structure.
- If something is unclear or missing in PROJECT.md, ask me. Don't guess or invent endpoints.
